name: securenow
description: Production security for your web apps: a security brief of what's attacking them, investigations of any IP or alert with traces, logs and IP reputation, plain-English questions over your traffic, the approval queue for blocks SecureNow's AI prepared, noisy-rule tuning and a weekly report, plus project setup and a code audit that turns findings into production detections in coding agents. Investigate access is read-only; with Investigate and respond, every block, rate limit and rule change is previewed and waits for your yes.

interface.shortDescription: Production security for your web apps
interface.longDescription: Connects your agent to SecureNow through the hosted connector (OAuth). Ten skills: a security brief of what's attacking your apps, investigations of an IP or alert with traces, logs and IP reputation, plain-English questions over your traffic, the approval queue, responses (block, rate limit, trust), noisy-rule tuning, a weekly report, project setup, and a code audit that turns findings into production detections. You choose Investigate (read-only) or Investigate and respond when you connect; every change is previewed and waits for your yes.
defaultPrompt: What's attacking my apps right now?
